title: 社媒营销：用LinkedIn和Instagram获客

intro.background: 你需要通过LinkedIn和Instagram开发海外文具买家，发布产品内容、互动评论、建立专业形象。
intro.desc: 社媒是外贸人低成本获客的重要渠道。本课覆盖LinkedIn个人品牌打造、产品内容发布、买家互动开发、Instagram视觉营销等全流程。
tasks: 通过评论和私信开发买家
outcomes: 社媒成为稳定获客渠道

oneLiner.en: Hi, I came across your company profile and noticed you specialize in eco-friendly stationery retail. We manufacture refillable markers that are selling well in EU supermarkets — would you be open to a quick call next week?
oneLiner.cn: 您好，我看到您的公司资料，注意到您专注于环保文具零售。我们生产的可换芯马克笔在欧洲超市卖得很好——您下周有空快速通个电话吗？

vocab.ex: Make sure your LinkedIn profile is complete and professional.
vocab.exCn: 确保你的LinkedIn个人主页完整且专业。

vocab.ex: Posts with questions get higher engagement.
vocab.exCn: 带问题的帖子互动率更高。

vocab.ex: I sent him a DM after commenting on his post.
vocab.exCn: 我在他的帖子下评论后给他发了私信。

vocab.ex: Use relevant hashtags like #stationery #officesupplies to reach buyers.
vocab.exCn: 使用#文具 #办公用品等相关话题标签来触达买家。

vocab.ex: Social media is a great source of warm leads.
vocab.exCn: 社媒是暖潜在客户的重要来源。

vocab.ex: Consistent branding across all platforms builds trust.
vocab.exCn: 所有平台一致的品牌塑造能建立信任。

mistakes.wrong: Hi, buy our markers, they are cheap!
mistakes.right: Love your store's focus on sustainable products — our refillable markers might be a great fit for your eco-conscious customers. Would you like a sample?
mistakes.cn: 不要直接发广告，先赞美对方，找到共同点，再自然引入产品。

mistakes.wrong: Connect with me, I sell stationery.
mistakes.right: I enjoyed your post about retail trends in Germany. We supply similar retailers with eco-friendly markers — would love to connect and share insights.
mistakes.cn: 连接请求不要只说'我卖文具'，要提到对方的内容，说明连接价值。

basic.en: I came across your profile and was impressed by your work.
basic.cn: 我看到了你的主页，对你的工作印象深刻。

basic.en: Would you be open to connecting?
I'd love to hear your thoughts on this.
basic.cn: 我很想听听你对这个的看法。

basic.en: Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
basic.cn: 有任何问题随时联系我。

advanced.en: I noticed your company recently expanded into the UK market — our refillable marker line has been doing very well with UK retailers, and I thought there might be some synergies worth exploring.
advanced.cn: 我注意到贵公司最近拓展了英国市场——我们的可换芯马克笔系列在英国零售商中表现很好，我想可能有一些协同效应值得探讨。

advanced.en: Rather than sending a generic catalog, I thought I'd share a quick case study — a similar stationery chain in Germany increased their marker category sales by 35% after switching to our eco-friendly line. Would you be open to a 15-minute call next week?
advanced.cn: 与其发一份通用目录，我想分享一个简短案例——德国一家类似的文具连锁店在切换到我们的环保系列后，马克笔品类销售额增长了35%。你下周有空通个15分钟的电话吗？
advanced.from: Would you be open to connecting

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Hi Sarah, loved your recent post about sustainable retail trends. We manufacture eco-friendly refillable markers that are selling well in EU supermarkets — thought it might resonate with your product range.
lines.cn: 嗨Sarah，很喜欢你最近关于可持续零售趋势的帖子。我们生产环保可换芯马克笔，在欧洲超市卖得很好——我想这可能与你的产品系列契合。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Thanks for reaching out! Refillable is definitely a growing category for us. Do you have a catalog you can share?
lines.cn: 感谢联系！可换芯确实是我们增长中的品类。你有目录可以分享吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely — I'll send our latest catalog along with a few best-seller SKUs that are particularly popular with UK retailers. Would you also be open to a quick 15-minute call next week to discuss your needs?
lines.cn: 当然——我会发送最新目录，以及几款在英国零售商中特别受欢迎的畅销SKU。你下周有空快速通个15分钟电话讨论你的需求吗？

scenario.q: 你在LinkedIn上看到一个潜在买家的帖子，想私信联系，你该怎么写开场白？
scenario.modelAnswer: Hi [Name], really enjoyed your post about [specific topic from their post]. We work with similar retailers in [their market] on [specific product] — I thought our [product benefit] might be relevant to your range. Would love to connect and share a quick case study if helpful.
scenario.cn: 嗨[名字]，很喜欢你关于[他们帖子中的具体话题]的帖子。我们与[他们市场]的类似零售商合作[具体产品]——我想我们的[产品优势]可能与你的系列相关。如果有帮助的话，很乐意加个好友并分享一个简短案例。

checklist: LinkedIn个人主页完整：头像、标题、经历、技能
每周发布2-3条有价值的内容（产品知识、行业洞察、客户案例）
每天花15分钟互动：评论目标买家的帖子
连接请求个性化，提到对方的具体内容
私信先建立价值，再谈产品
Instagram发布高质量产品场景图，使用相关话题标签

culture.title: 西方社媒商务文化：先给价值，再谈销售
culture.content: 欧美B2B买家对硬广非常反感。在LinkedIn上，成功的开发信逻辑是：先赞美对方的内容→找到共同点→提供价值（行业洞察、案例研究）→最后才自然引入产品。不要一上来就发目录和报价，那会被直接忽略。建立信任需要时间，先成为有价值的连接，再成为供应商。

aiPractice.situation: 你在LinkedIn上看到英国文具零售商Sarah的帖子，想私信开发她。她的公司专注于环保文具零售，最近发了一篇关于可持续零售趋势的帖子。

rounds.ai: Thanks for connecting, Quinn! I saw your message about refillable markers. Can you tell me more about your product range?
rounds.cn: 感谢加好友，Quinn！我看到了你关于可换芯马克笔的消息。你能多介绍一下你们的产品系列吗？
rounds.hint: 简要介绍产品系列，重点强调环保和可换芯，提到在欧洲市场的表现。

rounds.ai: That sounds interesting. What's your minimum order quantity and price range?
rounds.cn: 听起来不错。你们的最小起订量和价格范围是多少？
rounds.hint: 说明MOQ和阶梯价格，强调量大优惠，不要只给一个数字。

rounds.ai: The price is a bit higher than our current supplier. Can you do better?
rounds.cn: 价格比我们现在的供应商高一点。能再优惠吗？
rounds.hint: 强调价值差异（环保认证、可换芯、欧盟市场验证），询问订单量，提供阶梯价。

rounds.ai: OK, I'd like to try a sample order first. What's the process?
rounds.cn: 好的，我想先试个样品单。流程是怎样的？
rounds.hint: 说明样品流程：免费样品+运费到付，3-5天发货，确认后下正式订单。
